summary: RETEST of iter57 loan-type canonical parity fixes. All three FIX items verified PASS on the deployed frontend. FileDetailsPage edit dropdown now renders 19 canonical loan types grouped under 5 optgroups (Personal Loans / Home Loans / Vehicle Loans / Business Loans / Other Loans); bogus 'bt_topup_hl' is GONE; previously-missing values (balance_transfer_hl, top_up_hl, balance_transfer_topup_hl, msme_loan, lap, gold_loan, education_loan, other) are all present. Read-mode label now shows canonical labels ('Used Vehicle Loan BT', 'MSME Loan') via loanTypes.find. Save/reload roundtrip persists used_vehicle_loan_bt and msme_loan and both display canonical labels. FilesDashboard Add-New-File select (data-testid new-file-loan-type) exposes the same 19 grouped canonical options with no bogus value. Loan-type filter dropdown lists canonical labels (Balance Transfer + Top Up HL, MSME Loan, LAP, ...) with no bogus. GP (banothunithinnaik) is redirected from /admin/files/{id} to /agent and sees no Edit Details button — view-only enforced. Meta Web reuses FileDetailsPage so inherits the same canonical dropdown by construction.
